description: Vendored q-browser-kernel artifacts (K-005 build, refreshed by BWASM-Q-001, then by the declaration-order response-encoding fix) consumed by 'velqu build --target browser-wasm' (BWASM-B-005). Hash-pinned: the build fails closed if these bytes change.

provenance.refreshedBy: declaration-order fix 2026-09-16: q-schema-runtime SchemaIr::Object gained propertyOrder (encoder-side declaration order); kernel rebuilt so browser-side encoders match native declared-order response bytes. Same recipe as K-005/Q-007 (cargo build --release -p q-browser-kernel --features bindgen --target wasm32-unknown-unknown; wasm-bindgen --target nodejs).

glue.note: wasm-bindgen nodejs-target glue used as the deterministic transform source for the browser kernel module (see @velqu/cli browser-deploy).
